svg.title: LLM planner and local MCP environment architecture, with retrieval
svg.desc: A user prompt goes to a client-side pipeline: decompose the request into standalone sub-tasks, retrieve candidate skills for each sub-task via semantic search, then an LLM planner reads the candidates and decides create VP skill, update file skill, and analyze logs steps, exchanging skills, tools, and pipelines with a local MCP server. The local MCP environment then runs create VP, update file, and an analyze logs pipeline with discover, extract, LLM clean, final check, and fuse payload steps, feeding into a fuse environment.

g.text: Create platform, update file, find issues
